title: The Wayfarer
description: Guided first duel. Keeps the player's chosen class, relics, deck and the real Wayfarer encounter; scripts only the hands and the opponent's plays so every instruction is always true.

player_beats.prompt: Your hand is along the bottom. {card} costs {cost} Attunement — the number on the card — and you have {attune} available, counted in the ringed ATTUNE row. Tap the card, then tap the glowing lane on your side of the field.
player_beats.popup: Summoned. Most creatures must rest the turn they arrive — but the Student has SWIFT, so it can attack right away.

player_beats.prompt: Creatures attack straight across their own lane. Tap your Student, then tap the enemy lane directly opposite. That lane is empty, so the blow lands on {opponent} instead.
player_beats.popup: 2 damage. {opponent}'s Vigor — the number beside their name — dropped from 25 to 23. Bring it to 0 and the duel is yours.

player_beats.prompt: Your Student has attacked and your Attunement is spent — {attune} of {attune_max} left. Tap END TURN.
player_beats.popup: {opponent} takes a turn now. Watch what they do.

opponent_actions.label: The Wayfarer summons a Thorn Sprout across from your empty lane.

player_beats.prompt: Attunement refills every turn and grows by one — you now have {attune} of {attune_max}. {card} costs {cost}. Tap it, then tap the glowing lane facing the Thorn Sprout.
player_beats.popup: The Initiate has GUARD: enemy attacks aimed at your empty lanes are pulled onto it instead. It has no SWIFT, so it rests this turn.

player_beats.prompt: Your Student rested overnight and is ready. Tap it, then tap the enemy lane across from it — still empty, so it hits {opponent} again.
player_beats.popup: {opponent}'s Vigor 23 → 21. Every creature attacks once per turn, and only into the lane straight ahead of it.

player_beats.prompt: Nothing left to do. Tap END TURN and watch the Sprout.

opponent_actions.label: The Thorn Sprout attacks your Initiate — and breaks on its Guard.
A second Sprout appears, this time facing your Student.

player_beats.prompt: Attunement is {attune} of {attune_max} now — enough for {card} at {cost}. Tap the card, then tap the glowing lane. Spend it every turn; it does not carry over.
The Sprout that hit your Initiate is gone, so the lane across from it is open. Tap the Initiate, then tap that empty enemy lane.
player_beats.popup: Another 2 damage — {opponent}'s Vigor 21 → 19. An open lane is an open road to the enemy's Vigor. Keep them open.

player_beats.prompt: A Sprout now blocks your Student's lane. Tap the Student, then tap the Sprout. When creatures fight, BOTH deal their Attack to the other at the same time.
player_beats.popup: The Sprout is destroyed. Check whether your Student survived — a creature dies when damage reaches its Vigor. Trade wisely.

player_beats.prompt: That is everything you need. Tap END TURN — from here the duel is yours to win.
player_beats.popup: Summon with Attunement. Attack straight across. Open lanes hit Vigor; blocked lanes trade blows. Long-press any card to read it. Now finish {opponent}.

opponent_actions.label: The Wayfarer hesitates... and passes. The rest is up to you.
